svg.title: Sandburg architecture
svg.desc: Claude Code with the sandburg plugin on your machine connects through Tailscale to the GPU pod. There, mcp-proxy on port 9090 routes /service/mcp with a bearer token to the MCP servers for Blender, FreeCAD, build123d, KiCad, ngspice, OpenModelica, Inkscape, ComfyUI, the browser and voice. The tailnet also reaches the file server on port 8090, the noVNC desktop on 6080 and the ComfyUI web UI on 8188.
